entities.name: SAICAR synthetase
observations: Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt B8DTV0 (Bifidobacterium animalis subsp. lactis); 250 aa, 100% identity and coverage.
Annotated EC 6.3.2.6; Pfam SAICAR_synt (PF01259.25) spans residues 6–236.

entities.name: SAICAR formation
observations: Catalyzes PRIA-carboxylate + L-aspartate + ATP → SAICAR + ADP + phosphate + 2 H+ (Rhea RHEA:22628).

entities.name: De novo IMP biosynthesis
observations: Annotated in purine metabolism and de novo IMP biosynthesis; reaction is the SAICAR-forming step.
